title: Display color doesn’t match picture
text: Display color doesn’t match picture. I bought this clock because of the electric blue display color. However, the actual color is a deep royal blue.

product_metadata.title: SHARP Easy to See Alarm Clock with Jumbo 2” Numbers - Bright Blue LED Display - Easy Set-up & Simple to Use –See from Across The Room! - High/Low Alarm Volume
features: JUMBO 2" LED DISPLAY - Easy to see and read from across the room!
HIGH & LOW VOLUME CONTROLLED Choose the loud alarm setting for heavy sleeper & the low setting for those who wake more easily
HIGH & LOW DIMMER CONTROLLED Adjust display's brightness with 2 step dimmer control

EXTREMELY SIMPLE TO SET-UP & OPERATE - The cool clock has been designed with absolute simplicity in mind! The control buttons are on front of the clock for easy access! Easy for boys, girls, toddler, kids, teens, seniors and the elderly.
BATTERY BACK-UP - Electric operated with battery backup (2 x AA batteries not included)
